reviews.title: Data Changes
reviews.text: In theory, this app could be very useful for tracking heart changes throughout the day and night. But I found a disturbing kids out change of data. I appreciate the capacity to track every change and drop it into aCSV file. I sent my cardiologist one such file illustrating a day only to return to that day a week later and find the info is completely different for that very same day. Also, yesterday while cycling, Ride with GPS recorded a max of 137 bpm and HeartWatch recorded a max of 89 bpm.

reviews.title: Bad Customer Support
reviews.text: Don’t bother messaging the developer for support if you have any issues with the app; they are not helpful at all.

reviews.title: Stürzt immer ab
reviews.text: Seit 2-3 Monaten stürzt die App auf der Apple Watch immer ab. Ich habe Apple s10. Davor hatte es immer funktioniert.

reviews.title: Horrible Customer support
reviews.text:
Seems like the developers hired a bunch of new people. Problems come up and they get stumped. 
I communicated for three days day straight, only to be left hanging. Contacted Apple support to fix a simple issue. Fixed for a short time, and now back to square one again. Laziness?? Or may they don’t use or understand their own products??

reviews.title: Was Working Well, but…
reviews.text:
App was working well. It stopped checking my pulse today. 

Now, when I try to start the app on my phone it shows a message saying I haven’t listed my birthdate in the Apple Health app, which I definitely have! After verifying that the date was there and restarting my iPhone and my Apple Watch, I tried to open the the HeartWatch app again. I got the same message about my birthdate had not been entered into the Apple Health app!

Also the pulse reading still will not work-HELP!

reviews.title: Not at all accurate anymore
reviews.text:
This was helpful for awhile but for the past couple months it’s very inaccurate.   

I have to monitor my heart rate for a serious medical condition I have.   This app has become so inaccurate it’s no longer safe for me to rely on

After trying everything in the hopes of making it consistent again I deleted this app and found one that is reliable

reviews.title: One Star
reviews.text: For an app I had to purchase with another app that I did not need, I used both for a year. Checked my data because I have health issues and have since 2019 and this app has not given me not one ounce of information. In the year I have had this app installed on my devices in hopes of CONTINUOUS tracking it has done just the opposite. Thank you. My medical team also thanks you for wasting their time.

reviews.title: App Changed—New Privacy Concerns
reviews.text:
Why do you need all health app data for the app to function properly?

Holding app functionality hostage behind data mining scheme. Summary: “Just give us access to all these unrelated health details, we promise never to look at them. And we promise with this extra data the app can calculate your heart rate that you already don’t need calculations for because you gave us the raw data.”

The app refuses to function now that you’ve added full health data access requirements. Worked fine before this, you don’t need access to everything just to read my heart rate sensor.

You don’t need my birthday to calculate anything when you have access to the sensor that is on my arm! Just do the thing you were designed for and read and write only my heart rate and get your greedy hands off of my PHI.

Quoted requests from the app itself:
“Your one time build was cancelled as HealthKit access was disallowed, probably due to locking your device.
You can try again and it will resume from where you left off.” (I didn’t lock my device it showed this error immediately upon trying to look at any heart rate details in the app.)

“You don't seem to have entered your birthdate in your Apple Health app profile. This is required for heart rate calculations.” (It’s not, I get my HR through the sensor.)

reviews.title: viel zu kompliziert (jedenfalls für mich)
reviews.text: Zugegeben, es wird eine Menge an Daten angezeigt. Das Ganze wirkt für mich aber sehr überladen und wird daher leider sehr unübersichtlich und ist nicht intuitiv für mich.

reviews.title: Keine Ruheherzfrequenz
reviews.text: Diese App bietet keine Anzeige der Ruheherzfrequenz, was ziemlich ungewöhnlich ist. Somit ist sie für mich leider nicht brauchbar. Außerdem sind die Kreise viel zu groß und man muss sehr viel scrollen. Alles viel zu groß!

Update: Es wird mal langsam Zeit für ein Update !!!

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
Does not allow you to actually take an EKG, or look up data in real time. Instead, it offers the ability to put aggregate data into colorful charts similar to the ones already available in the health app. As far as I can tell it adds nothing.

Ascertaining this was nontrivial, and it decidedly conflicts with the impression given by the App Store listing.

Don’t waste your money.

reviews.title: Не работает
reviews.text: Приложение постоянно сбоит. Пропадает синхронизация с приложением здоровье. Регулярно теряются данные. Не получается это исправить.

reviews.title: Doesn‘t work anymore
reviews.text: Seit ein paar Tagen funktioniert die App nicht mehr. Auch der die App AutoSleep funktioniert nicht mehr. Alle Daten sind weg und nach dem öffnen versuchen beide Apps sich ohne Erfolg zu aktualisieren. iPhone 16+ und neuerste Firmware

reviews.title: Warum nur für Experten?
reviews.text: Wie clever wäre es, die gesammelten Daten so aufzubereiten, dass man auch als Laie verstehen kann, was Sache ist - bzw. an die Fachlichkeit herangeführt wird. Das würde mir helfen, meinen Körper besser zu verstehen und Prävention zu optimieren. Stattdessen werde ich mit Daten, Fachjargon und Abkürzungen sowie einem dysfunktionalen “Journal“-Tab erschlagen und denke nur: Danke. Hilft mir nicht im Ansatz.

reviews.title: Not for iWatch4
reviews.text: I was sad that in February when my iOS was updated and the watch was updated, I lost all of the heart rate stuff. They recommended this app, but it does not work for my system. It keeps telling me that I need to add my birthday to my health app. But it is there. I would like a refund. This doesn’t work for me.

reviews.title: Voilà 10€ euros de perdu
reviews.text: Application inutile qui reprend les mêmes données que celle d’origine d’Apple, et qui est rangé d’une façon encore plus bordélique. Finalement je préfère bien paramétrer celle d’origine

reviews.title: Doesn’t integrate with Apple Health app
reviews.text:
Just downloaded the app and set all notifications and allow app to read Health app. Unfortunately when I go to open the app it pops up a window indicating “You don’t seem to have entered your birthdate in your Apple Health app.”  Checked my Health app and confirmed my birthdate is entered. Don’t understand why I’m getting this message but if this app can read a simple piece of data from my Health app then I seriously doubt it will accurately read important data like my heart rate, etc. . .  
Deleting app.

reviews.title: ECG doesn’t work
reviews.text: Every time I try to use the ECG feature it tells me to hold my hand still as my hand is on a flat surface not moving. It use to work but the last year it will only go for maybe 5 seconds before it resets to 30 seconds

reviews.title: Leider keine gute App
reviews.text: Ich benutze die AutoSleep App vom gleichen Entwickler schon Jahre und bin mit sehr zufrieden damit. Da HeartWatch dort beworben wird habe ich mir auch diese App gekauft. Ich muss jedoch sagen das diese App weder flüssig läuft, noch eine Mehrwert für mich bringt. Die Schlafgesundheit wird in AutoSleep wesentlich besser dargestellt und für eine tägliche BPM und HRV Anzeige brauche ich nicht noch eine extra App. Abgesehen davon hakt die App auch meinem iPhone 15 Pro sehr.
